newsitem.title: UK: Hungary cbank launches repricing of $350 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Hungary cbank launches repricing of $350 mln loan.

text.p: LONDON, November 22 (LPC) - National Bank of Hungary has launched the repricing of a $350 million syndicated loan, arranger and coordinator Deutsche Morgan Grenfell announced.
Pricing on the credit, which was put in place in August and has 4.5 years left to run, is 20 bps over LIBOR.
ABN AMRO Bank, Bankgesellscahft Berlin, Central European Internatinal Bank, Chase Investment Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, NatWest Markets and Sakura Bank are arranging the credit.

Banks participating in the existing transaction are invited to re-commit with either an amount equal to the current level or with a larger amount. Banks committing more than their original amount will be paid 7.5 bps upfront, while those keeping participation at the same level will be paid 4.5 bps.
